svg.title: bytedance/deer-flow: 3.3% AI-signed commits
svg.desc: 3.3% of 478 recent commits in bytedance/deer-flow carry a disclosed AI agent signature (newest 478 commits, since 2026-10-20). Claude Code 2.7%, GitHub Copilot 0.4%, OpenAI Codex 0.2%. No signature found does not mean human-only.
